t_power.instructions: For Power (t_power), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Main appliance power only; not the switch for an individual feature. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_power: Power is not requested.

t_work_mode.instructions: For Mode (t_work_mode), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Main operating mode. Auto mode is different from Comfort Auto. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_work_mode: Mode is not requested.

t_temp.instructions: For Temperature (Celsius) (t_temp), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Celsius setpoint only. A Celsius temperature requires t_temp_type=0 too. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_temp: Temperature (Celsius) is not requested.

t_temp_f.instructions: For Temperature (Fahrenheit) (t_temp_f), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Fahrenheit setpoint only. A Fahrenheit temperature requires t_temp_type=1 too. Do not convert to Celsius. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_temp_f: Temperature (Fahrenheit) is not requested.

t_temp_type.instructions: For Temperature Unit (t_temp_type), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Required companion of a temperature setting: Celsius=0, Fahrenheit=1. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_temp_type: Temperature Unit is not requested.

t_fan_speed.instructions: For Fan Speed (t_fan_speed), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Fan speed. Turbo/Super is a separate function, not a fan speed. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_fan_speed: Fan Speed is not requested.
criteria.6: Set Fan Speed to Medium Low.
criteria.8: Set Fan Speed to Medium High.

t_fan_mute.instructions: For Quiet (t_fan_mute), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Indoor unit quiet only; different from outdoor quiet. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_fan_mute: Quiet is not requested.

t_super.instructions: For Super Mode (t_super), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Super/Turbo/powerful/rapid cooling or heating function; separate from fan speed. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_super: Super Mode is not requested.

t_up_down.instructions: For Up and Down Swing (t_up_down), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Continuous up-and-down swing switch; fixed vertical positions use t_swing_angle. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_up_down: Up and Down Swing is not requested.
criteria.0: Set Up and Down Swing to Off.
criteria.1: Set Up and Down Swing to On.

t_indoortemp_detection.instructions: For Comfort Auto (t_indoortemp_detection), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Comfort Auto based on indoor temperature detection; different from Auto operating mode. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_indoortemp_detection: Comfort Auto is not requested.

t_left_right.instructions: For Left and Right Swing (t_left_right), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Basic left-and-right swing switch; specific horizontal directions use t_swing_direction. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_left_right: Left and Right Swing is not requested.
criteria.0: Set Left and Right Swing to Off.
criteria.1: Set Left and Right Swing to On.

t_swing_angle.instructions: For Airflow (t_swing_angle), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Vertical airflow position. Use the option value, not the position number in its label. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_swing_angle: Airflow is not requested.
criteria.0: Set Airflow to Up and down swing.

t_swing_direction.instructions: For Horizontal Airflow (t_swing_direction), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Horizontal airflow direction. Splayed/both-sides airflow is value 2. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_swing_direction: Horizontal Airflow is not requested.
criteria.1: Set Horizontal Airflow to All Right.
criteria.2: Set Horizontal Airflow to Both sides.
criteria.3: Set Horizontal Airflow to Left and Right Swing.
criteria.4: Set Horizontal Airflow to All Left.

t_eco.instructions: For Energy Saving (t_eco), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Energy saving/Eco function; not an operating mode value. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_eco: Energy Saving is not requested.

t_purify.instructions: For Air Purification (t_purify), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Air purification; different from the LED display/Dimmer. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_purify: Air Purification is not requested.

t_swing_follow.instructions: For AI Wind (t_swing_follow), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. AI Wind human-sensing airflow; different from AI Smart/TMS. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_swing_follow: AI Wind is not requested.
criteria.1: Set AI Wind to Blow Towards.
criteria.2: Set AI Wind to Do Not Blow.

t_8heat.instructions: For 8° Heat (t_8heat), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. 8-degree Celsius frost-protection heating; different from Heat operating mode. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.omit: Do not send t_8heat: 8° Heat is not requested.

t_sleep.instructions: For Sleep Mode (t_sleep), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. Sleep profile selection. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.

criteria.3: Set Sleep Mode to Youth Sleep.
criteria.4: Set Sleep Mode to Child Sleep.

t_dimmer.instructions: For Dimmer (t_dimmer), select the value explicitly requested in query, or omit if not requested. LED display/panel light; different from air purification. Off=0, On=1. Do not infer extra settings from another requested feature.
